# Fonseca Fitness Case Logo Layer Pack - 2026-06-27

Source: `../vector-batch-vtracer-transparent-2026-06-13/fonseca-fitness-front-left-chest-dark.svg`

Recommended for the blue 3D-printed snap case lid.

## Files

- `fonseca-case-logo-01-offwhite-base-disc.svg` - simple off-white circular base. Print first / lowest layer.
- `fonseca-case-logo-02-navy-shapes.svg` - navy logo shapes. Print above base.
- `fonseca-case-logo-03-red-shapes.svg` - red logo shapes. Print above base.
- `fonseca-case-logo-04-offwhite-detail-lines-optional.svg` - optional off-white detail strokes. Use only if the logo is large enough.
- `fonseca-case-logo-layer-proof.html` - browser proof showing the stack.

## Slicer Use

Import all SVG layers into the slicer as separate objects, keep their scale/alignment identical, then assign filament colors per object. Recommended order from bottom to top: off-white base, navy shapes, red shapes, optional off-white details.

For a 0.4 mm nozzle, avoid using the optional detail layer unless the badge prints at roughly 60 mm wide or larger. At smaller sizes, the detail strokes may be too thin.
